_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: piqueserver
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: A server for Ace of Spades 0.75, the voxel shooter, for OpenSpades and BetterSpades players. Runs capture the flag or territory control with piqueserver's scripts, on maps of your own or generated ones.
startup: v="$(cat .piqueserver-version) $(python3 --version)"; if [ "$v" != "$(cat .venv/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing piqueserver $(cat .piqueserver-version)"; { python3 -m venv --clear .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check "piqueserver==$(cat .piqueserver-version)" && echo "$v" > .venv/.raptor-installed; } || exit 1; fi; [ -f config/config.toml ] || .venv/bin/piqueserver --copy-config -d config || exit 1; m=false; [ "{{PUBLIC}}" = 1 ] && m=true; u=false; [ "{{UPDATE_CHECK}}" = 1 ] && u=true; pw=; [ -z "{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}" ] || pw=", \"passwords\": {\"admin\": [\"{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}\"]}"; exec .venv/bin/piqueserver -d config -j "{\"port\": {{SERVER_PORT}}, \"name\": \"{{SERVER_NAME}}\", \"max_players\": {{MAX_PLAYERS}}, \"game_mode\": \"{{GAME_MODE}}\", \"master\": $m, \"release_notifications\": $u$pw}"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# piqueserver: checks the chosen version on PyPI. piqueserver itself is
# installed when the server starts, into its own Python environment
# (.venv), for the Python version it runs. Your settings, maps and scripts
# in config/ are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    url=https://pypi.org/pypi/piqueserver/json
else
    url="https://pypi.org/pypi/piqueserver/$want/json"
fi
code=$(curl -sSL -o "$work/pq.json" -w '%{http_code}' "$url") || fail "PyPI can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ "$code" = 404 ] && fail "piqueserver has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 1.4.2."
[ "$code" = 200 ] || fail "PyPI can't be reached right now (HTTP $code). Reinstall to try again."
version=$(jq -r .info.version "$work/pq.json")
echo "$version" > .piqueserver-version
echo "Installed piqueserver $version. It's set up when the server starts."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The piqueserver release, such as 1.4.2, or latest for the newest. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: ctf (capture the flag), tc (territory control), or a game mode of your own in config/game_modes, without .py.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for /login in the game, which gives a player the admin commands. Empty, nobody can log in as admin.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: List the server on the public server list.

variables.name: Check for updates
variables.description: Ask GitHub for a newer piqueserver at start and tell players with admin rights about it.
